case_name: Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017) 10 SCC 800
summary: The Supreme Court struck down Exception 2 to IPC Section 375 (now BNS 63) to the extent it applies to girls below 18 years of age, making sexual intercourse with a minor wife an offence. Adult marital rape is still not explicitly criminalized in India as of 2024, though BNS 64 Exception 2 remains contested. SIGNIFICANCE: For cases involving minor wives, this judgment is critical.
ratio: Sexual intercourse with wife under 18 years is rape regardless of marriage.
